firm_data.firm_description: Conway, Donovan & Manley, PLLC, is a full-service litigation firm formed by three trial lawyers who draw from a wide variety of experience to provide clients with a well-rounded, experienced approach to their litigation needs. With a focus on quality, not quantity, their attorneys bring more than 75 years of combined experience in providing comprehensive legal services to individuals and businesses in New York State.
notable_facts: The firm was formed by three trial lawyers.
The attorneys bring more than 75 years of combined experience.
